articles.summary: Enode and BMW Group have entered a partnership to enable a fully supported integration for BMW and MINI vehicles. The collaboration enables a high-quality, reliable connection that gives drivers access to the energy apps and services they rely on to manage charging and make the most of renewable energy.
articles.title: Enode and BMW Group partner to unlock smarter, more connected charging for European drivers

articles.summary: Product at Enode sits at the centre of how we build. It’s about understanding complex systems, solving hard problems with clarity and making things feel simple for the people who use our platform. In this edition of Behind the Circuit, we speak with Julien Rizzo, Senior Product Manager for EV charging, about his path from fintech to energy, why the connectivity layer is so important and how he thinks about building both products and processes that last.
articles.title: Behind the Circuit: Meet Julien Rizzo, Senior Product Manager

articles.title: Inside Enode
